title: ToolResponse
description: Canonical local tool API response. Returned by the daemon after validating and executing a ToolRequest.

status.description: ok = success, rejected = governance policy rejection, error = internal failure.

result.description: Command-specific result payload. Null when status is error.

message.description: Human-readable message (error detail, governance rejection reason, etc.).

governance_result.description: Governance result produced by policy evaluation, when applicable.

responded_at.description: Timestamp at which the daemon produced this response.
